content.comment_body: Hello everyone! I’m encountering a similar issue with my existing .snp project files, which I originally created using [product_name] version [version_no] on my computer. They worked fine before, but after updating to MAC OSX [version_no], I can no longer open them. The files are visible in the open dialog (see attachment), but clicking on them does nothing—the program simply shows a blank page. Has anyone found a solution for this? Kind regards, [user_name]
Please avoid posting the same problem more than once. You already shared this issue in another discussion: [product_name]: Program recognizes the folder but does not open it.

This thread is now closed due to duplicate questions. The other discussion titled '[product_name]: Program recognizes the folder but does not open it' is already published in the [product_name] - Software conference. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is unable to open .snp project files that were created with the same software and hardware setup. The problem started after an operating system update, with the software showing no reaction or error message when attempting to open the files. This situation is causing confusion and frustration due to the lack of feedback from the application.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to access and edit existing .snp projects even after updating the operating system, and would like the software to provide direct feedback or error messages when an operation cannot be completed.
